_about: Breadth set r7, TypeScript (ARB-166), frozen before any clone or scan. TypeScript applications and services drawn from GitHub topics ['self-hosted', 'web-application', 'webapp', 'dashboard', 'cms', 'api-server', 'rest-api', 'backend', 'monitoring', 'automation', 'bot', 'discord-bot', 'telegram-bot', 'chatbot', 'scraper', 'crawler', 'cli', 'proxy', 'saas', 'workflow', 'llm-app', 'rag', 'mcp-server', 'electron-app', 'home-automation', 'media-server', 'whatsapp-bot'], each with >= 1000 stars, pushed since 2026-08-26, not archived/fork/template, an OSI licence, TypeScript >= 60% of bytes, size <= 400000 KB, a .github/workflows directory, no path Windows cannot check out, a description and topics that do not name a library/SDK/plugin/component kit/tutorial/boilerplate/list, a file showing it is deployed or installed as an application (Dockerfile or compose file, Procfile, fly.toml/render.yaml, systemd unit, electron-builder/forge/tauri config, platformio.ini/sdkconfig, debian/control, or man pages; some real CLIs lack all of these and are lost), and not named anywhere in Arbiter's tools, packs, docs or fixtures (held-out sets, gold repos, ground-truth sources, every other breadth manifest). Chosen from metadata and file names only; candidates shuffled with seed 20261026, then split with seed 20261027 into 'dev' (30: rule fixes may read these) and 'heldout' (measurement only, never used for tuning). Each repo is pinned to its default-branch HEAD at freeze time.
